name: 5'-Guanidinonaltrindole
summary: 5'-Guanidinonaltrindole (5'-GNTI) is an opioid antagonist used in scientific research which is highly selective for the κ opioid receptor. It is more potent and selective than the commonly used κ-opioid antagonist norbinaltorphimine. It has a slow onset and long duration of action, and produces antidepressant effects in animal studies.

pharmacology.text: 5'-Guanidinonaltrindole (5'-GNTI) is an opioid antagonist used in scientific research which is highly selective for the κ opioid receptor. It is more potent and selective than the commonly used κ-opioid antagonist norbinaltorphimine.

uses.text: 5'-Guanidinonaltrindole (5'-GNTI) is an opioid antagonist used in scientific research which is highly selective for the κ opioid receptor. It is more potent and selective than the commonly used κ-opioid antagonist norbinaltorphimine.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It is a laboratory tool rather than a drug people take, and its effects in people have not been described.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它是實驗室工具，而不是供人使用的藥物，在人體的作用也沒有相關描述。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它是实验室工具，而不是供人使用的药物，在人体的作用也没有相关描述。

fact.en: It is built from naltrindole, itself derived from the opioid blocker naltrexone, and is one of the most selective blockers known for the κ-opioid receptor, which is linked to dysphoria and stress.
fact.zh: 它由naltrindole衍生而來，而naltrindole又來自鴉片類拮抗劑納曲酮（naltrexone）。它是已知對κ鴉片受體最具選擇性的拮抗劑之一，而這個受體與情緒惡劣及壓力反應有關。
fact.zhHans: 它由naltrindole衍生而来，而naltrindole又来自鸦片类拮抗剂纳曲酮（naltrexone）。它是已知对κ鸦片受体最具选择性的拮抗剂之一，而这个受体与情绪恶劣及压力反应有关。
